regret a decision: I deeply regret a decision I made last year to quit the swimming team before the big race.
我很後悔去年在大賽前退出游泳隊的決定。
regret to inform you: We regret to inform you that your flight to Tokyo has been canceled because of the typhoon.
我們很遺憾通知您，您飛往東京的班機因颱風已取消。
live to regret: If you don't study for the exam now, you will live to regret it when you see your score.
如果你現在不準備考試，等你看到成績時將來一定會後悔。
I regret that: I regret that I never told my grandfather how much I loved him before he passed away.
我很遺憾，在祖父過世前從沒告訴他我有多愛他。
regulate the market: The government passed new laws to regulate the market and stop companies from raising prices unfairly.
政府通過新法律來管制市場，阻止公司不公平地漲價。
regulate body temperature: Sweating helps people regulate body temperature when they exercise on hot summer days.
流汗能幫助人們在炎熱夏天運動時調節體溫。
regulate traffic: When the traffic lights broke down, a police officer stood at the crossing to regulate traffic.
紅綠燈故障時，一名警察站在路口管制交通。
regulate one's emotions: Deep breathing can help children regulate their emotions when they feel angry or upset.
深呼吸可以幫助孩子在生氣或難過時調節情緒。
strictly regulated: The use of fireworks is strictly regulated in this city, so you need a permit to set them off.
這座城市嚴格管制煙火的使用，所以你需要許可證才能施放。
rehearse a play: The drama club stayed after school every day to rehearse a play for the school's anniversary.
戲劇社每天放學後留下來，為校慶排演戲劇。
rehearse a speech: Before the graduation ceremony, Amy stood in front of the mirror to rehearse a speech she had written.
畢業典禮前，艾咪站在鏡子前練習她寫好的演講。
rehearse old arguments: Every time my parents talk about money, they rehearse old arguments instead of finding a solution.
每次爸媽談到錢，他們就重提老論點，而不是找出解決辦法。
a well-rehearsed answer: When the reporter asked about the scandal, the actor gave a well-rehearsed answer that sounded too perfect.
記者問到醜聞時，那位演員給了一個練習過的答案，聽起來太完美了。
reinforce the idea: The teacher showed several real examples to reinforce the idea that small habits can make a big difference.
老師舉了幾個真實例子，強化小習慣能帶來大改變的想法。
reinforce stereotypes: Some TV ads reinforce stereotypes by showing only women cooking and only men fixing cars.
有些電視廣告只呈現女性煮飯、男性修車，強化了刻板印象。
reinforce the wall: Before the typhoon arrived, workers used steel bars to reinforce the wall of the old school building.
颱風來臨前，工人用鋼筋加固老舊校舍的牆壁。
reinforce one's position: The candidate used new survey data to reinforce his position that the city needs more parks.
那位候選人用新的調查數據鞏固他認為城市需要更多公園的立場。
reinforce the message: The posters in the hallway reinforce the message that bullying is never acceptable at our school.
走廊上的海報強化了「我們學校絕不容許霸凌」的訊息。
reject an offer: She decided to reject an offer from a big company because she wanted to start her own business.
她決定拒絕一家大公司的提議，因為她想自己創業。
reject a proposal: The committee voted to reject a proposal to build a shopping mall in the middle of the park.
委員會投票否決了在公園中央蓋購物中心的提案。
reject the idea: Most students decided to reject the idea of having classes on Saturdays and voted against it.
大多數學生決定駁斥週六上課的想法，並投票反對。
be rejected by peers: Children who are rejected by peers at school often feel lonely and lose interest in learning.
在學校被同儕排斥的孩子常感到孤單，並失去學習興趣。
the body rejects the organ: After a transplant, there is always a risk that the body rejects the organ, so patients take special medicine.
移植手術後，總是有身體排斥器官的風險，所以病人要服用特殊藥物。
reject an application: The university may reject an application if the student forgets to send all the required documents.
如果學生忘記寄齊所有必要文件，大學可能會拒絕申請。
relate to others: Joining a sports team helped the shy boy learn how to relate to others and make new friends.
參加運動校隊幫助那個害羞的男孩學會如何與他人產生共鳴、結交新朋友。
relate a story: Every evening, the old sailor would relate a story about his adventures at sea to the village children.
每天傍晚，老水手都會向村裡的孩子講述他海上冒險的故事。
be related to: Scientists believe that the rise in sea levels is related to global warming and melting ice.
科學家認為海平面上升與全球暖化和冰層融化有關。
relate A to B: Our teacher asked us to relate what we learned in history class to events happening in the world today.
老師要我們將歷史課學到的內容與當今世界發生的事件連結起來。
can't relate: My friends love talking about living in a big city, but as a country girl, I just can't relate.
我的朋友喜歡聊住在大城市的生活，但身為鄉下女孩，我就是無法感同身受。
